name: Martí Cifuentes
bio: Managed QPR, Leicester City, Hammarby, Aalborg and Sandefjord before joining Portland in July 2026. Watch how the team builds through pressure and reacts after losing possession.

name: Xavi Calm
bio: Joined Portland in August 2026 after working with Cifuentes at Leicester City. His coaching route includes QPR, Hammarby and managerial roles in Spain.

name: Javi Ortiz
bio: Joined in August 2026 from Leicester City. Previously coached at Sandefjord and in Espanyol’s academy. Watch the keeper’s starting position and passing options.

name: Ned Grabavoy
bio: Leads the sporting operation and roster construction. A front-office role, separate from match-day coaching.

name: Jack Dodd
bio: Part of Portland’s technical leadership. Explore his official biography for his career and responsibilities.
